home.hero.title: Realism for your simulation starts here.
home.hero.text: We're a virtual airline that brings the routine of a real airline to your simulator, flying across Brazil and the Americas.
home.about.title: Born on the coast, made for the sky
home.about.imageHint: Coming soon: real shots of the Litoral fleet in the simulators.
home.about.lead: Litoral is a Brazilian VA dedicated to serious simulation, with a 100% Boeing 737 fleet.
home.about.p1: Our pilots fly on the IVAO and VATSIM networks, using MSFS 2020, MSFS 2024, X-Plane and Prepar3D, with hubs in Guarulhos, Florianópolis, Brasília, Manaus and Fortaleza, plus a cargo operation out of Viracopos.
home.about.missionLead: Our mission is to deliver a realistic, professional and fun airline experience.
home.about.p2: Here you build your career from First Officer to Captain, plan every flight with SimBrief and track your progress through hours and points. All in a welcoming environment where we learn together and share our passion for aviation.
home.experience.title: Real operations. Your next challenge.
home.experience.text: Every step of the flight follows airline logic: from choosing the route and aircraft to landing and reviewing your performance.
home.experience.operate.title: 100% Boeing 737 fleet
home.experience.operate.text: From the 737-600 to the MAX 8, plus the 737-800BCF freighter. Every route respects the real range of the chosen aircraft.
home.experience.brief.title: Planning with SimBrief
home.experience.brief.text: Book the flight and open SimBrief already filled in. Route, fuel and weights show up in your briefing before takeoff.
home.experience.fly.title: ACARS and scoring
home.experience.fly.text: Your flight is tracked from push back to the gate. Landing, procedures and deviations set the points that take you to the left seat.
home.numbers.totalFlightsText: Valid flights since Litoral was founded.
home.numbers.h1: Flights from Brazil to the Americas
home.numbers.h3: Works with MSFS, X-Plane and P3D
home.numbers.h5: Career from First Officer to Captain
home.numbers.pilotsText: Active pilots flying with the LITORAL callsign.
home.numbers.hubsText: Passenger and cargo bases across Brazil.
home.numbers.destinationsText: And growing with every new route.
home.flights.title: Last flights
home.flights.empty: Litoral's first flights will show up here. The next one could be yours.
home.cta.title: Ready for takeoff?
home.cta.text: Create your account, pick your hub and fly your first Litoral flight.
home.footer.disclaimer: Litoral Linhas Aéreas is a virtual airline for flight simulation, not affiliated with any real airline.
